name: Radicchio

schedule.notes: Fall is the prize — cool nights are essential for tight heads with deep red color.
Heads firm and red. Cut at the soil; some types resprout for a second cut.

harvest.cues: Head firm to squeeze, vibrant red with white veins, before bolt stalk appears.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge whole 2 weeks. Excellent grilled — bitterness mellows with char.

varieties.name: Chioggia (Palla Rossa)
varieties.notes: Classic deep-red ball. The grocery-store radicchio.

varieties.name: Treviso Precoce
varieties.notes: Long elongated head like a romaine. Earlier and milder.

varieties.name: Castelfranco
varieties.notes: Cream with maroon speckles. The variegata. Beautiful and mild.

notes: Many varieties need a temperature shift (warm spring, cold fall) to head up tightly — read the seed packet. Cutting the head back to the crown can produce a smaller second head.
